This stance contrasts with other industry leaders' more cautious outlooks on AI's impact on employment.

description: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has divested his stake in a New York City real estate fund for a fraction of its value, selling for just six cents on the dollar. The fund, A&E Real Estate, confirmed the sale, citing the challenging market for rent-stabilized apartments.
